limitations: The original parser emitted no BrowserType.* member entries. BrowserType appears as an export interface, but its methods and properties are missing from entries.

Recovered from types.d.ts (comment-stripped declaration parse): connectOverCDP, connect, executablePath, launch, launchPersistentContext, launchServer, name. Overloads were collapsed to one inventory row per member name.
Electron, Android, and nested option-object members may also be incomplete in the original parser output.

The original parser attached some nested option fields to parent types (for example Page.trial, Page.waitUntil, Browser.viewport). Those rows are preserved as parser output and are not treated as proof that the parent object has those fields.
EventEmitter overloads (on/once/off and related) are represented as events plus Page.addListener-style methods where the parser emitted them; types.d.ts recovery does not re-emit every overload.
Type-level inventory is necessary but not sufficient for compatibility. Schema presence does not imply source or behavior compatibility.

types_dts_provenance.recovery_method: Strip block and line comments from Playwright 1.62.1 types.d.ts, then parse export interface, export type, export const, and export namespace declarations with brace matching. Interface members are split on top-level semicolons. Events are taken from on(event: 'name') overloads and inventoried as Type.event.name. BrowserType generic syntax (BrowserType<Unused = {}>) is handled by skipping generic parameters before the body brace. Nested inline option object fields inside method parameters are not exploded into additional member rows.

compatibility_sufficiency: Type-level inventory is necessary but not sufficient for compatibility. No schema, source, or behavior result in this Phase 0 contract is passing or implemented. Compatibility remains unverified or unsupported until a later phase records conformance evidence.
